licence.title: Licence

licence.renewIntro: The licence now ends on {{date}}. Choose a later last valid day. It takes effect at once and is recorded in the school's audit log too.

recovery.title: Sole Chief Admin recovery
recovery.intro: Only when the school has exactly one Chief Admin who has lost both the authenticator and the recovery codes. A code goes to the school's registered contact; the school reads it to you. It only resets two-step sign-in: the Chief sets up a new authenticator at the next sign-in. It never sets or shows a password, and the school sees it in its audit log.
recovery.start: Send recovery code to the school
recovery.sent: A code was sent to {{to}} for {{chief}}. Ask the school to read it to you.
recovery.reason: Why, and how the school proved who they are
recovery.reasonHint: At least 20 characters. The school sees this.
recovery.done: Done. The Chief signs in with their own password and sets up a new authenticator.

usage.title: Usage
usage.computed: Worked out inside the school {{when}}. Numbers only.
usage.notYet: Not worked out yet. It runs every 15 minutes, or use Refresh numbers.

security.title: Security overview
security.intro: Counts only, with no names or content. The details are in the school's own audit log, which needs a support grant from the Chief Admin.

payments.title: Payments
payments.appendOnly: Payments cannot be changed. To put a mistake right, record a correction with a minus amount and a note.

alerts.title: Security alerts

promotion.newClasses: New draft classes, because the school has no class with that number yet: {{list}}
promotion.newSections: New draft sections for students moving up: {{list}}
promotion.warning: After this, {{year}} can only be viewed: no marks, attendance or cards in it can change.
promotion.confirmBody: Everything in the preview happens at once: {{to}} becomes the current year and {{from}} closes.
promotion.done: Done. {{to}} is now the current year and {{from}} is closed.
promotion.planned: Moving into {{name}}, made in the unpaid-dues step.

dues.title: 3. Unpaid fees
dues.none: Nobody owes fees for this year. Nothing to carry forward.
dues.intro: {{count}} students still owe {{total}} for {{year}}. Decide each balance before the year closes: carry it forward into the new year, or leave it in {{year}}.
dues.choiceFor: What happens to the balance of {{name}}
dues.leaveWarning_one: 1 balance stays in {{year}}. After the year closes it can only be viewed: Campus TAB can no longer collect it.
dues.leaveWarning_other: {{count}} balances stay in {{year}}. After the year closes they can only be viewed: Campus TAB can no longer collect them.
dues.done: {{carried}} balances ({{carriedAmount}}) now open in {{to}}; {{left}} left in the closing year.
dues.blocking_one: 1 unpaid balance is not decided yet (step 3).
dues.blocking_other: {{count}} unpaid balances are not decided yet (step 3).

verify.title: Report card check
verify.subtitle: What the school issued for this QR code
verify.current: This is the current version of the report card.
verify.replaced: This version was replaced by a newer one. Ask the school for the current card.
verify.note: This page shows only who the card belongs to. Marks are on the card itself.
verify.notFound: We could not find a report card for this code. Check that the whole code was scanned, or ask the school.

fees.amountInvalid: Enter rupees, with at most two digits after the point.
fees.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. Kept with the record and in the audit log.

home.counterHint: Take a payment and print the receipt
home.closingsHint: Close your day, or confirm someone else's
home.adjustmentsHint: Rebates, waivers and refunds, proposed and approved
home.reportsHint: Daily collection, dues, heads, cheques; Excel export
home.onlineHint: The school's payment gateway and nightly checks

classStatus.title: Class {{label}}: fees
classStatus.note: You see only paid or pending. Amounts stay with the office.

my.title: Fees
my.noChildren: No children are linked to your account.
my.waiting: Waiting for the payment to be confirmed. This takes a few seconds; you do not need to do anything.
my.paid: Payment received. Receipt {{number}} is in your receipts.
my.failed: The payment did not go through. No money was taken; you can try again.
my.mismatch: The payment needs checking by the school office. They have been told.

fake.title: Test checkout
fake.note: This is the local test gateway: no real money moves. It sends a signed webhook just like the real gateway.

counter.title: Fee counter
counter.today_one: Your counter since your last closing: {{count}} receipt · {{amount}}
counter.today_other: Your counter since your last closing: {{count}} receipts · {{amount}}
counter.amountHint: Less than the selected dues is a part payment.
counter.chequeNote: The dues show Pending clearance until the cheque clears. A bounced cheque reverses the payment.
counter.numbers: Receipt numbers run in sequence for the year and are never reused.
counter.done: Receipt {{number}}: {{amount}} received by {{mode}}. A copy is in the family's app.

ledger.title: Fee history · {{year}}
ledger.note: Entries are only added, never edited. A mistake is undone by a reversal entry.

receipt.title: Fee receipt
receipt.pending: A cheque or draft counts once the bank clears it.
receipt.bounceBody: The payment is reversed in the ledger and the dues are owed again. The receipt keeps its number, marked bounced.
receipt.cancelBody: Cancelling reverses the payment in the ledger. The Principal approves it; the receipt keeps its number, marked cancelled.
receipt.cancelAsked: Sent for approval. The receipt stays valid until the Principal approves.
receipt.cancelPending: A request to cancel this receipt is waiting for a decision.

closings.title: Day-end closing
closings.closed: Your day is closed. Someone else now counts and confirms the cash.
closings.note: Someone else confirms your closing; you never confirm your own.
closings.noCash: No cash was taken; check the other payments against the bank or the UPI app.

adjustments.title: Adjustments
adjustments.intro: Rebates, waivers, fine waivers, refunds, scholarships and carry-forwards. The Clerk proposes, the Principal approves; nobody approves their own.
adjustments.proposeNote: Nothing changes until the Principal approves it.
adjustments.percentHint: Of the chosen instalment, for example 10
adjustments.ownNote: You proposed this, so someone else approves it.

cancellation.title: Cancel receipt {{number}}
cancellation.effect: Approving reverses the payment in the ledger. The receipt keeps its number.

reports.title: Fee reports
reports.exportNote: Exporting asks for a code from your authenticator app, is recorded in the audit log, and every file shows who exported it, when, and for which school. A large export alerts the Chief.

setup.title: Fee setup
setup.noPlans: No plans yet. Add the fee heads first, then a plan for each group of classes.
setup.editNote: Changes apply only to instalments not raised yet. Dues already raised stay as they are unless adjusted.
setup.siblingHint: Off every child after the first in a family. Leave empty for none.
setup.raiseNote: Dues are raised every night as instalments come due (within 30 days). Raising again never charges twice.
setup.raised: {{raised}} instalments raised for {{students}} students. {{skipped_no_plan}} students have no plan.

online.title: Online payments
online.none: No gateway yet. Families pay at the school office until the Chief adds one.
online.secretsNote: The secret and the webhook secret are stored encrypted and never shown again. Money settles straight into the school's bank.
online.keepBlank: Leave empty to keep the one saved.
online.fakeNote: The local test gateway works only on a development computer. Real schools use Razorpay.
online.reconNote: Each night the gateway's settlement report is matched against our online payments. Anything that does not match goes to the Clerk.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: How the school uses personal data, whom to contact, your consents and your requests.
privacy.noTracking: Campus TAB has no advertising, tracking or outside analytics. Your activity is never profiled.

notice.title: Privacy notice
notice.none: The school has not published its privacy notice yet.

grievance.title: Questions or complaints about personal data
grievance.name: Contact
grievance.none: The school has not named a contact yet. Ask the school office.

consents.title: Your consents
consents.intro: Each yes or no is for one child and one purpose. You can change it at any time; the school sees only your latest answer. Saying no to PEN or APAAR removes that number from the record.
consents.noNotice: You can answer once the school publishes its privacy notice.
consents.noChildren: No children are linked to your account.

purposes.pen: Keep the PEN (Permanent Education Number) on the record
purposes.apaar: Keep the APAAR ID on the record
purposes.photo_public: Use photos on the school website, notice boards or social media
purposes.third_party_sharing: Share details with outside partners (trips, competitions, insurance)

requests.title: Your data requests
requests.intro: Ask for a copy of what the school holds, a correction, or for details to be erased. The school answers by the due date shown.
requests.detailsHint: What should the school do? At least 10 characters.
requests.sent: Sent. The school will answer by {{date}}.

retention.import_batches: Import files and their check reports

office.title: Privacy office
office.nothing: You have no privacy office tasks.
office.outcome: What was done, or why it is refused
office.outcomeHint: The person sees this. At least 10 characters.
office.copy: Download a copy of the data
office.eraseBody: The name, date of birth, ID numbers, the school’s own fields, sign-ins and the contact details of guardians with no other child here are removed for good for {{name}}. Attendance, marks, report cards, fees and the audit log are kept as school records. This cannot be undone.
office.eraseConfirm: Type the admission number to confirm
office.legalReview: Have a lawyer check the notice before the school goes live. A published version can never be changed: publish a new version instead.
office.noticeBodyHint: Plain text. Leave an empty line between paragraphs.
office.publishBody: Everyone sees the new version, and everyone is told it changed. Parents answer consents again against the new version.
office.retentionIntro: Each kind of data is kept for a set time. A dry run lists what is past its time and deletes nothing. Delete only after reading it; that asks for a code from your authenticator app. Every night a dry run is made and you are told.
office.never: Never deleted here: the audit log and the fee ledger (school records).
office.dryRunResult: Dry run on {{date}}: {{count}} past their time (from {{oldest}} to {{newest}}).
office.dryRunEmpty: Dry run: nothing is past its time.
office.listed_one: 1 record is past its time. Nothing was deleted.
office.listed_other: {{count}} records are past their time. Nothing was deleted.
office.incidentsIntro: Record every suspected personal data breach at once and add each step. Tell the Data Protection Board within 72 hours, and the people affected. Follow the breach runbook.
office.boardDeadline: Tell the Data Protection Board by {{date}}
